bundle.shortDescription: Capture phased RGB-D scans and reconstruct them offline.
bundle.longDescription: ScanLan records calibrated RGB-D phases from Kinect v2, Azure Kinect DK, or Orbbec Femto Mega and reconstructs a colored point cloud plus an RGB-reprojected textured mesh.
